Learning Area: Guided Science Activities / Living and Non-Living Things
Coverage: Observe and describe differences; identify examples; growth, response, reproduction.
Animal external body parts and roles; plant leaves, roots, stems and roles in obtaining water/nutrients.
Air, food, water, shelter; dependence on other living things/environment; protect and conserve environment.
Movement caused by wind/water and people; pushing, pulling, rolling, carrying; effects of size, shape, heaviness, material, surface texture.
Measure and describe changes in position relative to original position: closer, farther, left, right.
